verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 crew successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego'; R2: 'Floating in the Pacific Ocean... after splashdown'; R3: 'successfully completed a parachute-assisted splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego'; R5: 'splashdown... off the coast of California'; R6: 'successfully splashed down off the coast of San Diego'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the successful splashdown location.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 splashdown occurred on April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. ET.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Friday, April 10, 2026... 8:07 p.m.: Splashdown'; R2: 'Friday... at 8:07 p.m. Eastern time'; R3: '8:07 p.m. SPLASHDOWN... at 8:07 p.m. EDT'; R4: 'April 10, 2026... 8:07 p.m. EDT'; R5: 'April 10... 8:07 p.m. EDT'; R6: '8:07 p.m. ET'
verifications.reasoning: All sources directly state the exact date and time of splashdown.

verifications.claim: 8:07 p.m. ET corresponds to 0007 GMT April 11.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: '8:07 p.m. EDT (0007 GMT on April 11)'
verifications.reasoning: R5 directly provides the exact time conversion.

verifications.claim: Artemis II Flight Day 10 marked the return of the Crew Dragon "Orion".
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Flight Day 10 crew wakeup... Orion spacecraft'; R2: 'Orion spacecraft'; R3: 'Artemis II Flight Day 10... Orion spacecraft'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Flight Day 10 as return day but identify spacecraft as 'Orion', not 'Crew Dragon' (which is SpaceX's unrelated vehicle).

verifications.claim: The Crew Dragon "Orion" returned after a 10-day trip around the Moon.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: '10-day milestone mission... Orion spacecraft'; R2: '10-day journey... Orion spacecraft'; R3: 'approximate 10-day mission around the Moon... Orion spacecraft'; R5: '10-day mission... Orion spacecraft'; R6: '10-day journey around the moon... Orion capsule'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm 10-day moon mission but identify spacecraft as 'Orion', not 'Crew Dragon'.
